title: Ministration
summary: MINISTRA'TION, noun [Latin ministratio.] The act of performing service as a subordinate agent; agency; intervention for aid or service. -- Because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration

inlines.v: MINISTRA'TION, noun [Latin ministratio.] The act of performing service as a subordinate agent; agency; intervention for aid or service. -- Because their widows were neglected in the daily ministrations. Acts 6:1. 1. Office of a minister; service; ecclesiastical function. As soon as the days of his ministration were ended. Luke 1:23.
